findings.criterion: [operator-attested] a full `rebar review-plan` run emits zero cache warnings when caching is working, evidenced by the run's aggregate `cache_write_tokens > 0`
findings.detail: No concrete operator attestation is recorded in the ticket. The 'FIXED' comment explicitly acknowledges this criterion 'needs an operator, cannot be self-attested' and that 'the live run needs real provider credentials and a human attestation.' No comment names a run ID, a specific timestamp, or observed log output from a live run showing zero cache warnings alongside aggregate cache_write_tokens > 0. The attestation bar (≥1 verifiable specific: reference id, named actor, measured outcome) is not met.
findings.remediation: An operator with live provider credentials must run `rebar review-plan` end-to-end, confirm zero cache-ineffective warnings in the output, and record the result as a ticket comment naming: (1) the run/session ID or timestamp, (2) the observed aggregate cache_write_tokens value (must be > 0), and (3) confirmation that no cache-warning lines appeared.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
